title: 4 pilots killed in mid-air collision of Philippine military planes
text:

 The crash involved two SF-260 aircraft during a training flight at the Fernando Air Base in Batangas province, the air force says
 1 -MIN READ 1 -MIN 1 Listen Reuters and Agence France-Presse Published: 3:42pm, 24 Oct 2026 Updated: 3:46pm, 24 Oct 2026 Two Philippine Air ⁠Force ⁠aircraft crashed during ⁠a training flight at an air base south of the capital Manila, killing four pilots, the military said on Saturday.
 The aviation accident on Friday involved two SF-260 aircraft at the Fernando Air Base in Batangas province, the Philippine Air Force said in ⁠a statement.
 “Both aircraft went down within the base perimeter, with no other casualties reported,” Philippine Air Force spokesman Colonel Alvin Capinguian said in a statement.
 An investigation was opened to determine the cause of the mishap, and Capinguian said the air force’s fleet of SF-260s had been temporarily grounded as a precaution.
